models.title: 100mm Fan Mount
models.description: Modular 100mm-class fan mount with TPU gaskets and a two-piece conical clamp that grips the fan's tapered upper body.

worksWith.label: VIVOSUN 4 Inch 130 CFM Inline Duct Fan

models.title: Pet Collar Tag
models.description: A two-color pet collar tag with your choice of body shape (circle, hexagon, or bean), an embossed name, and a raised border edge. Attaches to the collar with a standard split ring through the integrated loop.

models.title: Slide-On Collar Tag
models.description: A slide-on pet nameplate — the collar strap threads through a slot in the tag, so nothing dangles, jingles, or snags. Set your strap's width and thickness and the tag wraps itself around it; type a name and the plate grows to fit. The name sits flush in the top face and every edge is rounded.

models.title: Fi Mini GPS Case
models.description: Protective case for the Fi Mini GPS tracker. Supports an optional QR code — enter your phone number or address so anyone who finds your dog can reach you.

models.title: Fi Mini GPS Case (Captive Collar)
models.description: One-piece Fi Mini cover — no cap, no screws. The collar threads through a channel along the underside, enclosed at both ends and held by a lip down the middle, and the tracker presses up through that same slot. Supports an optional QR code.

filament.note: Case body — the slot is an interference fit, so it has to flex

models.title: UGREEN Finder Duo Air Case (Captive Collar)
models.description: The captive-collar cover re-sized for the UGREEN Finder Duo Air. One piece, no cap, no screws: the collar threads through a channel along the underside and the tracker presses up through the same slot. Supports an optional QR code.

filament.note: Case body — soft (85A); the square tracker is a 62% stretch across the lip

models.title: QR Leash Tag
models.description: A QR code that slides onto a leash — one piece, two filaments, no hardware. The webbing threads through a slot across the middle and the code fills the whole 29mm face. Set your leash's width and thickness and the tag wraps itself around it. Prints face down so the code comes out flat and crisp.

filament.note: QR modules — the swap lands in the 1mm band against the build plate

previews.label: Print orientation — QR on the plate

models.title: Parametric QR Case
models.description: A one-piece case for a small rectangular object — a GPS tracker, a key fob, a battery. Type in the object's length, width and height and the pocket sizes itself around it; the outer face carries a QR code. Prints face down: the code lies on the build plate and the pocket opens upward, so nothing bridges and nothing needs support.

filament.note: QR modules — the swap lands in the 1mm band against the build plate

previews.label: Print orientation — QR on the plate, pocket up

models.title: QR Sign
models.description: Two-color QR sign — encode any URL on a 235mm rounded plate. Prints as a single multi-material job with the QR modules embossed in a contrasting filament.

models.title: Private Property Sign
models.description: Three-color property warning sign — white plate with the text recessed and inlaid flush (no relief): "Private Property" and "No Trespassing" in red, the rest in black. The plate auto-sizes to fit the text. Prints as a single multi-material job.

models.title: Air Purifier Wall Shelf
models.description: Wall-mounted round shelf for the Levoit Core 200S air purifier. 230mm plate with diagonal truss struts; four screws into the wall.

hardware.label: #6 pan-head wood screw or M3.5 wall anchor

models.title: 1/4" Hex Bit Holder
models.description: A rounded-edge block with blind hexagonal holes (closed bottom, 1mm base) that grip 1/4" hex-shank driver bits by friction. 12mm tall with graduated internal grip bumps on all six flats. Sized for 0.25mm fit clearance in 64D TPU. Available in 3–10 hole sizes on 15mm spacing.

filament.note: Flex is required for friction grip

models.title: Parametric Shelf
models.description: Open-frame shelf, printed as a single piece — two side walls with solid corner columns and a hex-lattice interior, capped by a solid top plate. Triangular gussets brace the four internal top corners. Adjust the width, depth, height, wall / top thickness, hex cell size, and gusset length to fit your space.

models.title: Flashforge Adventurer 5M Filament Sensor
models.description: Ball-plunger filament runout sensor for the Flashforge Adventurer 5M. Two-piece 64D TPU: a body that slips over the 7 mm print-head boss (held by one M3 self-tapping screw), and a cap that mounts a D2F-01F pin-plunger microswitch with two M2 screws which also fasten the switch through its own mount holes. A ball bearing rides in a 40°-tilted pocket tangent to the 1.75 mm filament surface and drops 0.65 mm when filament runs out, releasing the switch. Top of the body accepts a 4 mm-OD PTFE tube (12 mm grip) with a 45° funnel down to the filament bore.

filament.note: Flex is required — body stretches over the printer boss, M3 and M2 threads self-tap into the walls, and the ball snaps into the cavity through the access channel before the cap is fitted

hardware.label: Ball bearing, ~4 mm dia (e.g. from a 608 skateboard bearing — measure yours)
M3 x 8 self-tapping screw (body to printer boss)
M2 x 10 self-tapping screw (cap + switch to body)
PTFE tube, 4 mm OD × 2 mm ID (any length)

models.title: Educator ET-300 Knob Aide — Knurled
models.description: Diamond-knurled cap for the Educator Mini ET-300 intensity knob — bigger, grippier turning surface with raised diamond bumps in a staggered lattice, like a traditional knurled knob. A circle-plus-cross keying cutout and a wider bottom pocket clear the knob shaft and body; a 1 mm solid top caps the whole thing. An optional Kanix logo is engraved into the top face — single-color print shows a shallow recess; multi-material print fills the recess with a contrasting color.

previews.label: Knob aide (knurled, logo inlay — customize below)

models.title: VRIG Camera Mount Retention Guard
models.description: Rectangular 64D TPU sleeve that slides over the VRIG AC-91 magnetic quick-release adapter at the camera-to-mount interface. Open top and bottom; the four walls physically constrain the joint so a side impact can't shear the magnetic connection.

filament.note: Flex is required so the sleeve stretches over the joint and grips by friction

models.title: Parametric Split Tray
models.description: Parametric parts tray with bullnose walls and vertical sliding dovetail seams. Adjust length, width, wall diameter, wall height, base thickness (0 = open frame), and split factor (2×2 or 3×3). Each seam is a trapezoidal tongue on one piece + blind pocket on the mate — every piece is pressed straight DOWN to seat and pulled straight UP to release, no drop-in keys. Front lip auto-caps at 25 mm for easy reach-in. Default 500 × 500 mm with 25 mm bullnose walls splits into four 250 × 250 mm quadrants that fit on a ~250 mm bed (Qidi Q2 class).

parts.label: Tray cell — set piece_i / piece_j to pick which one

models.title: Under-Desk Cord Protector
models.description: Modular cord cradle that screws to the underside of a desk. The profile drops 3 in straight down, then wraps the outside of a 6 in circle for 135° (90 + 45) so cords leaving the desk are supported through the bend instead of kinked over an edge. 8 mm thick throughout. Each 150 mm segment interlocks with the next through a rib-and-groove joint that follows the whole profile — print as many as your desk is wide. Three screws per segment pass through the vertical wall itself — an angled round recess bored in from the cord side takes a #6 × 5/8 in pan-head screw driven straight up into the desktop, with its head bearing on the 2 mm of plastic left below the desk face, so the outside face stays solid and nothing protrudes into the cord channel. An optional prop finishes the half circle at the cradle's tip and runs straight up to the desk — a narrow beam, a solid full-width panel, or a hex screen — closing the tube and taking the sag out of a long run. It bolts onto the shell with M5 × 8 button heads driven into the plastic, in a half-lap that keeps the joint the same thickness as the rest of the tube, so it goes on after the cords are laid in, and takes the desk screws the same way the wall does — recessed and angled, here toward the outside of the tube so a driver can still reach them once it is closed. Prints standing on the grooved end with no supports.

hardware.label: #6 × 5/8 in pan-head wood screw, per segment
#6 × 5/8 in pan-head wood screw into the desk, per full-width prop (1 per narrow beam)
M5 × 8 button-head cap screw into the cradle, per full-width prop (1 per narrow beam)

models.title: XYZ Test Cube
models.description: 30 mm calibration cube with X, Y, Z engraved on the +X, +Y, +Z faces. Quick end-to-end sanity check for slicer + printer coordinate system.

models.title: Scaffold Cube (1U)
models.description: The 1U cube of a printed building-block system — a 200 mm cube, the largest square that fits a Flashforge Adventurer 5M bed. Each of the 6 walls is independently solid, empty, or a hex lattice, and each of the 12 edges is independently bare or braced with an equal-leg right-triangle prism. Mix the 18 types to get an open frame, a closed box, a tray, a chimney, or anything between.

previews.label: Assembly: closet, 5×5 with an open 3×3 centre
